next_step: Run 7-day QPS stress POC (index ~2M docs) + finalize SLA/COGS; followed by security questionnaire sign-off
notes:
Account snapshot and recent activity:
- Background: Aurora Nexus runs a SaaS customer support platform serving multiple enterprise tenants. Primary goal = replace brittle keyword search with vector+rerank for KB answers across ~1.5-3M docs (articles + transcripts). High QPS expected (target 400-800 qps for search endpoints during peak).
- Performance targets: CTO Marcus Lee quoted: "Need sub-200ms p95 for retrieval path at 600 QPS; reranker allowed up to 350-400ms p95 if parallelized." Cost sensitivity: engineering lead wants <$0.02/query overall (embeddings+rerank) at scale.
- Current stack: in-house embedding service (InferX small on-prem dev), uses FAISS for ANN. Seeking hosted API to reduce ops and get quantization + batching recommendations. Interested in Redwood hosted to avoid managing GPU fleet and use Redwood Optimize suggestions.
- Security/compliance: SSO (SAML) required, audit logs for queries, KMS for key management, and a directive to keep EU tenant residency for 20% of customers (need clarification on how hosted handles multi-region residency).
- POC plan agreed (from discovery call 2026-03-01):
  * Redwood to run 7-day stress POC against their sandbox index (~2M docs) with simulated QPS patterns (burst and steady).
  * Two-stage retrieval validation: dense embedding recall -> top-50 candidate rerank with a smaller T5 reranker variant. Measure end-to-end p95/p99 and cost per successful resolution.
  * Evaluate Redwood Optimize recommendations: quantization profile, batching policy, prefix/KV caching for session-heavy chat flows.
- Timeline & commitments:
  * 2026-03-01: demo w/ Marcus + Eng leads (recording ff-20260301-aurora-demo).
  * 2026-03-04: security questionnaire submitted (Drive doc). Redwood SE (Tom) completed initial SSO mock configuration.
  * 2026-03-08: Redwood provided preliminary cost estimate and two model configs (cpu-friendly reranker vs GPU-accelerated dense rerank).
  * 2026-03-10: Engineering requested detailed COGS breakdown per 100k queries (Tom assigned).
- Quotes and posture from calls:
  * Marcus (CTO): "We will pay for reliability but not for wasteful overhead — show us quantized costs with equivalent quality."
  * Head of Support Ops: "Must not regress recall for low-frequency KB articles — reranker must preserve long-tail retrieval."
- Open questions / blockers:
  * How hosted API enforces regional data residency for EU-only tenants (legal needs an answer).
  * Clarify Redis/ANN caching strategies Redwood will use to hit 200ms p95 at 600 QPS.
  * Finalize which reranker model to use in POC (cost vs latency tradeoff).
- Next steps (short):
  1) Redwood: deploy POC config + run baseline traffic script (tomorrow).
  2) Aurora Nexus: provide sanitized sample corpus (2M docs) and traffic profile CSV.
  3) Both: security call w/ legal (w/e week) to resolve data residency guardrails.
- Misc references: Jira RDW-1129 opened for POC infra questions; internal thread IDs above for follow-up.
